label: Trade Me Jobs
terms_note: Trade Me API terms: in-trade only; application review; OAuth.

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **partial** (Trade Me API for in-trade sellers / vertical partners). Lane `assist` → **keep**. Confidence high.
auth: 1. Apply for API access (in-trade) → consumer key/secret → OAuth.
reference.limits: - In-trade requirement; no casual / buyer-side tools. - Trade Me API terms: in-trade only; application review; OAuth.

fields.name: consumer_key
fields.help: Trade Me API consumer key of your registered application (My Trade Me → Developer options; API access is granted after Trade Me reviews the application).

fields.name: consumer_secret
fields.help: The application's consumer secret: sent as the OAuth 1.0a PLAINTEXT signature '<consumer secret>&' over HTTPS (Trade Me's documented PLAINTEXT workflow).

adapter.terms: Trade Me API terms: applications are reviewed and access is for approved (in-trade) uses; calls are rate-limited. Applying for a job happens on Trade Me.

search_postings.note: GET /v1/Search/Jobs.json with an application-level OAuth 1.0a PLAINTEXT Authorization header (consumer key + '<consumer secret>&', no member token; rows ≤ 25 without a member token). category is a Trade Me jobs category id. These are employment listings: buyer is the employer (Company); StartDate/EndDate use Trade Me's '/Date(ms)/' JSON format and stay in raw with JobLocation, JobType and pay-range fields. The listing page is https://www.trademe.co.nz/a/jobs/listing/<id>.

get_posting.note: GET /v1/Listings/<ListingId>.json (full body; job listings add Company, ShortDescription and application details in raw).

not_offered.me: Member endpoints (/v1/MyTradeMe/Summary) need a member access token from the OAuth 1.0a RequestToken → Authorize → AccessToken flow; this adapter signs as the application only.
not_offered.submit_bid: Job applications are made on Trade Me (Apply Online); Trade Me's bidding API applies to auctions, not job listings.
not_offered.list_messages: Member messaging needs a member token (not offered by this application-signed adapter).
not_offered.send_message: Asking an employer a question needs a member token (not offered by this application-signed adapter).
not_offered.credits: No credit balance for job seekers.

live_check.notes: requires consumer_key, consumer_secret; started, listed tools and answered a clean auth_error naming the variables
